paper_metadata.title: Design of Al – Fe – Mn alloy for both high-temperature strength and sufficient processability of laser powder bed fusion

L-PBF was performed at ambient temperature using a ProX 200 3D printer (3D Systems, Rock Hill, SC, USA) equipped with a Yb-fiber laser (wavelength = 1070 nm). The following process parameters were used: laser spot size ( σ ), ~100 µ m; powder bed layer thickness ( t ), 30 µ m ; hatch distance between adjacent scanning tracks ( h ), 100 µ m; laser power ( P ), 102 – 204 W; and laser scan speed ( v ), 0.6 – 1.4 m ⋅ s−1.
